projects.title: Tennis Analyst
projects.description:
Full-stack web app to track tennis match statistics in real time. Built with Python, Flask, and SQLite for the
  backend, and vanilla JavaScript for the frontend. Features user authentication, match history, and AI-generated
  practice plans based on match performance. Deployed on PythonAnywhere and installable as a PWA on iPhone.

  URL: https://fymc.pythonanywhere.com/login
